title: THE ELDERS SAIL FOR HOME--A STORM AT SEA--HOW HEBER FOUND FAVOR WITH
author: Orson F. Whitney
note: Published 1888. Whitney (grandson, later apostle). 68 chapters. Incorporates extensive verbatim journal extracts.

footnotes.text: Jackson County, Missouri, from whence the Saints were driven, is reputed to be the ancient site of the Garden of Eden.
